# Carolina Cravens

> Creative technologist in Dallas-Fort Worth, Texas.
> Nine years designing brand, campaign, web and AI-produced work for global luxury
> houses, a Nasdaq-listed company, and small businesses across Texas and Costa Rica.
> Works in English and Spanish. Available for freelance and full-time work.
> Contact: creativecravens@gmail.com or text (208) 402-8409. Prices: https://creativecravens.com/web-design-services.html

## Who she is

Carolina Cravens designs and builds. She is not only a visual designer: she
hand-codes websites, ships AI-assisted production work, and takes projects from
brief to live site herself.

- Based in Dallas, Texas. Serves Dallas, Fort Worth, Bedford, University Park,
  Highland Park, Plano, Frisco, Irving, Arlington and Richardson, and San Jose, Costa Rica. Works remotely anywhere.
- Bilingual, English and Spanish, for design and copy in either.
- Contact details are on every page of the site.

## Clients and employers

- Pacific Northern, Inc., 2022 to 2025. Campaign, visual merchandising and
  presentation design for LVMH, L'Oreal, Dior Beauty, Signet Jewelers and
  IWC North America. Designed an LVMH exhibit shown at Virgin Hotels New York.
  Advertising published in the VMSD LookBook. Green screen photo booth shown at
  COUTURE, Las Vegas, 2022.
- Legacy Housing Corporation (Nasdaq: LEGH), 2026 to present. In-house design
  across print and web. Led a product catalog redesign across four home lines,
  built a library of 65 custom vector icons, and designed a published two-page
  advertisement in the Manufactured Housing Association of Oklahoma directory.
- Independent since 2019. Apts. Centro Colon in San Jose, Costa Rica, brand and
  website. Lane Gang Capital Group for OAK'D BBQ. TriVan Roofing. Co-founder of
  DuoWeb Design Studio, 2021 to 2023. Blood in Blackwood, an author launch site.

## Services and published prices

Fixed prices rather than quote-on-request.

- Wix or Squarespace website build: $1,000 to $2,000
- Custom-coded website: $3,000 to $5,000
- Custom site with booking, stores, chatbots or real-time 3D: $6,000 to $9,000
- Landing page: $800 to $1,500
- Website redesign: $3,000 to $8,000
- E-commerce build: $4,000 to $12,000
- Brand identity package: $1,500 to $5,000
- Logo design: $400 to $1,200
- Social media management: $500 to $1,200 per month
- SEO optimization: $700 to $2,500
- Custom holiday pet portrait from your photo: $15
